task: mark plates and openings with chalk and pencil
tolerance_basis: assumed 1/8 in on a 16 in module
note: tool mass 0.1 kg is a pencil, assumed

task: move a stud, plate, header ply or cripple from the stack to its wall
note: mass runs from the mean piece to the heaviest (a 2x12 header ply)

task: cut headers, sills, cripples, jacks and plates to length
hold a piece in position against the layout
drive end nails with a framing nailer
tolerance_basis: half the face width, so the nail stays in the member

task: tilt a framed wall up and brace it
tolerance_basis: assumed 1/2 in over a wall, plumb
note: person-minutes; the lifting is by crew, crane or telehandler

task: move a 4x8 OSB sheet from the stack to the wall
hold and square a sheet on the frame
tolerance_basis: sheet edge must land on a 1.5 in stud face

task: cut out the window and door openings
note: router or saw, tool mass assumed like the nailer

task: nail sheathing, 6 in edge and 12 in field
bring OSB sheets up to the roof
note: hand height is above the stock robots' reach envelope, so no payload cell applies

task: lay and square a roof sheet
tolerance_basis: sheet edge on a 1.5 in truss face

task: nail roof sheathing
cut and fit a batt in a wall cavity
note: batt mass 0.5 kg is assumed, not sourced; far below any payload limit

task: carry a 4x8 drywall sheet
hold a wall sheet while it is screwed
tolerance_basis: screw must land on a 1.5 in stud face

task: hold a ceiling sheet while it is screwed
tolerance_basis: screw must land on a 1.5 in joist face

task: score and snap or cut around openings
drive drywall screws
note: screw gun mass 1.5 kg is assumed

task: tape, mud and sand joints, three coats
note: tool mass 2 kg is assumed; heights 0 to 2.44 m
